work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act lists the injuries done to religion by the Piedmontese government. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF9102-9103 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE 1 NOYEMBRIS ANNO MDCCCL Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
